packageRules.description: Hold kotlinx-io at its last Kotlin 2.2-built release. 0.9.x is compiled at language version 2.3, whose metadata cannot be read by consumers still on Kotlin 2.1 (e.g. the Detekt Gradle Plugin). See detekt/detekt#9330.

Hold kotlinx-serialization at its last Kotlin 2.2-built release. 1.10.x+ is compiled at language version 2.3, whose metadata cannot be read by consumers still on Kotlin 2.1 (e.g. the Detekt Gradle Plugin). See detekt/detekt#9330.
